footer.copyright: © 2026 TirpScanner. Independent SaaS & AI-Tool Deal Scanner.
footer.disclosureNote: * FTC/KFTC Disclosure: TirpScanner is an independent comparison service. We may receive affiliate commissions from certain vendors when you click our outbound links or sign up, at no extra cost to you. Plan prices are normalized for transparent evaluation.

disclosure.title: Affiliate & Editorial Independence Disclosure
disclosure.meta: FTC and KFTC affiliate disclosure: how TirpScanner earns commissions while keeping rankings strictly algorithmic.
disclosure.intro: In compliance with the U.S. Federal Trade Commission (FTC) 16 CFR Part 255 and the Korea Fair Trade Commission (KFTC) endorsement guidelines.
disclosure.s1body: TirpScanner operates with complete algorithmic separation between our deal comparisons, plan-price analysis, and commercial affiliate partnerships. No vendor can pay to alter their ranking, score, or placement order in our search and comparison engine. All rankings are computed deterministically from objective plan features, prices, and public rate cards.
disclosure.s2pre: When you click certain outbound buttons (such as deal buttons or links under
disclosure.s2post: ) and sign up for a plan, TirpScanner may receive an affiliate referral commission or hosting credit from the respective vendor.
disclosure.s2note: This referral compensation comes at zero additional cost to you. In many cases, our partner links provide special promotional signup credits (e.g. trial credits for new accounts) that reduce your starting cost.
disclosure.s3title: 3. Korea Fair Trade Commission Endorsement Disclosure Notice
disclosure.s3pre: When you sign up for a service through product or affiliate links on this site (
disclosure.s3post: ), TirpScanner may receive a referral commission or service credit from the vendor.
disclosure.s3note: All plan prices, deal scores, and rankings on this platform are determined solely by objective features and mathematical algorithms, and are never altered or distorted by commercial interests.
disclosure.s4body: To prevent click fraud without tracking personal browsing history, TirpScanner hashes client IP subnets using SHA-256 with rotating salts. We do not store raw IP addresses or sell user data to advertising brokers.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.meta: TirpScanner Privacy Policy: data collection, integration credential handling, retention, and your rights.
privacy.s1a: Account data: email, display name, Argon2id password hash (never plain-text passwords).
privacy.s1b: Organization and role membership for tenant isolation.
privacy.s1c: Integration credential metadata: KMS key reference, encrypted blobs, token fingerprints, granted scopes. Raw network tokens are sealed at submission and never logged.
privacy.s1d: Operational telemetry: request logs with IP-derived HMAC hashes (not raw IPs) for affiliate click attribution and abuse prevention.
privacy.s2body: We use data to operate the comparison service, attribute affiliate conversions, run deal alerts you subscribe to, and prevent fraud. We do not sell personal data and we do not use your account data for advertising.
privacy.s3body: Data is shared only with infrastructure subprocessors required to run the service (hosting, database, email delivery) and with affiliate networks in the form of pseudonymous click identifiers (SubID/ClickID) when you click an outbound deal link. No account credentials are ever shared.
privacy.s4body: Passwords use Argon2id; sessions are short-lived signed tokens; integration secrets use KMS envelope encryption with per-integration authentication context; tenant data is isolated per organization and enforced at the database layer. Security incidents follow the published incident runbook.
privacy.s5body: Account data is retained while your account is active. Disconnecting an integration immediately revokes and wipes its stored credential blobs. You may request full account and data deletion at privacy{'@'}tirpscanr.com; audit logs required for financial compliance are retained in anonymized form where the law requires.
privacy.s6body: Depending on your jurisdiction (including GDPR and Korean PIPA rights), you may request access, correction, export, or deletion of your personal data. Contact privacy{'@'}tirpscanr.com and we will respond within 30 days.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.meta: TirpScanner Terms of Service: account responsibilities, estimates, affiliate disclosure, and acceptable use.
terms.s1body: TirpScanner provides independent SaaS deal comparison, subscription plan-price estimation, and affiliate-linked vendor referrals. Comparison rankings are computed by deterministic algorithms only; vendors cannot pay for placement.
terms.s2body: You connect integrations that you own or are authorized to administer. Tokens are sealed with envelope encryption and used solely to operate features you explicitly enable, such as deal alerts. TirpScanner applies zero markup and never charges your vendors' bills.
terms.s3body: Plan-price estimates and price-drop alerts are informational: they reflect vendor data available at computation time and may lag promotions or regional pricing. Always confirm the final price on the vendor checkout page.
terms.s4pre: Some outbound links are affiliate links. If you purchase through them, TirpScanner may receive a commission or hosting credit at no extra cost to you. See the
terms.s5body: You must not abuse the service, circumvent rate limits or safety gates, probe other tenants' data, or scrape deal feeds in violation of vendor terms. We may suspend accounts that violate these terms or threaten platform integrity.
terms.s6body: Price calculations are transparent estimates based on vendor plan data, scenario inputs, and freshness indicators. They are not binding quotes; your vendor's checkout is authoritative.
terms.s7body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, TirpScanner is not liable for indirect damages, vendor outages, or subscription charges incurred on your vendor accounts. The service is provided "as is" without warranties of uninterrupted availability.
